judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a classic rubber ducky shape with a distinct body and head, colored bright yellow.
The duck must have an orange beak and a simple black dot for an eye.
Draw a white, claw-foot bathtub shape, showing the inside view with a visible rim.
requirements.note: white tub with rim, but plain peg feet, not claw-feet

requirements.text: Fill the lower portion of the bathtub with light blue water.
requirements.note: water reaches the rim; the tub reads as full, not lower portion

requirements.text: Ensure the water line is clearly visible across the duck's body, showing the lower third of the duck submerged.
requirements.note: translucent band shows the lower part of the duck submerged

requirements.text: Position the duck so it is floating on the water's surface, creating small, concentric circular ripples in the water around its base.
requirements.note: two ripple arcs around the duck

requirements.text: Depict soap bubbles as clusters of overlapping circles with a slight iridescence, using semi-transparent white, light pink, and light blue fills.
requirements.note: bubbles are plain white/light-blue circles; no pink or iridescence

requirements.text: Place a small cluster of bubbles on top of the duck's head.
requirements.note: small bubble cluster on the head

requirements.text: Place a large pile of bubbles against one side of the tub and a few floating on the water's surface around the duck.
requirements.note: small clusters at both rims; no large pile on one side
